findings.issue_text: InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.getForLogin() resolves cached IDs through session.identityProviders().getById(id), recursively re-entering the caching provider; it should use idpDelegate.getById(id) and explicitly apply the organization-aware wrapper
OrganizationCacheTest cleanup removes the literal alias "alias" instead of the created "idp-alias-" + i and "idp-alias-20" aliases, leaving identity providers behind and polluting subsequent tests

goldens.comment: InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.getForLogin() recursively calls session.identityProviders().getById() instead of idpDelegate.getById(), causing the cache lookup to re-enter the same caching layer.
Cleanup reference uses incorrect alias - should be 'idp-alias-' + i instead of 'alias'.
